trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.description: Start the automation when something happens, at a set time, or when you run it.

type.description: What starts it: an entity change, a daily time, one date and time, a manual run, startup or a Home Assistant trigger.
type.label: Type

entity.description: The entity to watch, such as binary_sensor.front_door.
entity.label: Entity

time.description: The time of day to run, as HH:mm in 24-hour time, such as 07:30.
time.label: Time

timeZone.description: The time zone of the daily time, such as Europe/Zagreb or UTC.
timeZone.label: Time zone

trigger.description: A Home Assistant trigger as in a YAML automation, written as JSON, such as {"trigger": "state", "entity_id": "light.hall"}.
trigger.label: Trigger

mode.description: If it triggers while running: Single ignores it, Restart starts over, Queued runs afterwards, Parallel runs alongside.
mode.label: Mode

manual.description: Whether Run now can start the automation from this trigger.
manual.label: Manual

startup.description: Whether to also run when Home Assistant starts; when not set, only a startup trigger runs then.
startup.label: Startup

at.description: The date and time to run once, with its offset from UTC, such as 2026-12-01T07:30:00+01:00.
at.label: At

condition.label: State condition
condition.description: Continue on If true or If false, depending on whether an entity has a given state.

state.description: The state to compare with, as Home Assistant stores it, such as on, off or home.
state.label: State

entity.description: The entity to check. For the entity that started the run, its state when the trigger fired is used.
entity.label: Entity

service.label: Call service
service.description: Run a Home Assistant service, such as turning on a light or sending a notification.

service.label: Service
service.description: The service to call, such as light.turn_on.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: The service's options you set, such as brightness or a message, each with its value.

returnResponse.label: Return response
returnResponse.description: Ask the service for its response, so later steps can use it.

target.label: Target
target.description: The entities, devices, areas, floors or labels the service acts on.

response.label: Response
response.description: What the service sent back, such as a weather forecast.

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: Wait a number of seconds before the next step.

seconds.description: How long to wait, up to about 49 days.
seconds.label: Seconds

custom.label: Custom C#
custom.description: A step you write in C#: one static method marked [Node]. Its parameters are the inputs and its return value is the output.

source.label: Code
source.description: The C# code: one static class with one method marked [Node]. Helper methods and types can sit beside it.

text.label: Text
text.description: Each parameter is an input pin.

result.label: Result
result.description: The return value is the output pin.

signature.label: Pins
signature.description: The pins the code gives: its inputs, outputs and the types they use, as worked out from the code.

if.label: If
if.description: Continue on If true or If false, depending on a yes/no value.

value.description: Yes continues on If true, no continues on If false.
value.label: Condition

and.label: And
and.description: Combine two yes/no values: the result is yes only when both are yes.

value.description: Yes when both values are yes.
value.label: Result

or.label: Or
or.description: Combine two yes/no values: the result is yes when at least one is yes.

value.description: Yes when at least one value is yes.
value.label: Result

xor.label: Exclusive or
xor.description: Combine two yes/no values: the result is yes when exactly one is yes.

value.description: Yes when exactly one value is yes.
value.label: Result

not.label: Not
not.description: Turn a yes/no value around: yes becomes no and no becomes yes.

value.description: The opposite of the value.
value.label: Result

compare.label: Compare
compare.description: Compare two values, such as whether a temperature is above 21.

operator.description: How to compare. Less than, at most, greater than and at least work only with numbers.
operator.label: Operator

left.description: The value to check, such as a temperature. Both values must be of the same type.
left.label: First value

right.description: The value to compare it with, such as 21.
right.label: Second value

value.description: Yes when the comparison holds, otherwise no.
value.label: Result

read_entity.label: Read entity
read_entity.description: Read an entity's current state and attributes for later steps to use.

entity.description: The entity to read. For the entity that started the run, its state when the trigger fired is used.
entity.label: Entity

value.description: The entity's id, state, attributes and change times; it does not update afterwards.
value.label: Entity state

constant.label: Constant
constant.description: A fixed value of the type you choose, for any number of steps to use.

type.description: The type of the value, such as Number or Text.
type.label: Type

value.description: The value to give, of the chosen type. Nothing can be connected to it.
value.label: Value

value.description: The value, as the chosen type.
value.label: Value

convert.label: Convert
convert.description: Change a value into another type, such as text into a number.

type.description: The type to change the value into, such as Number or Entity.
type.label: Type

value.description: The value to change. If it cannot be changed, the step that uses the result fails.
value.label: Value

value.description: The value, as the chosen type.
value.label: Value

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: End the whole run here, including any branches still running.

last_error.label: Error details
last_error.description: What went wrong on this path: the message of the most recent failure and the step that failed. Both are empty while no step has failed.

message.label: Message
message.description: What the failure says; empty when no step on this path has failed.

step.label: Step
step.description: The name of the step that failed; empty when no step on this path has failed.

log.label: Log
log.description: Write a message to the Home Assistant log.

level.description: How important the message is: Debug, Info, Warn or Error.
level.label: Level

value.description: What to write. Any value works; it is written as text.
value.label: Message

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.description: Run the steps in Body a set number of times, then continue with Done.

maxIterations.description: The loop stops with an error if it would run more often than this; at most 1000.
maxIterations.label: Maximum iterations

carry.description: Values each iteration can read and change, each starting from a value you set.
carry.label: Kept between iterations

exports.description: Values set inside the loop for steps after it; nothing else made inside the loop is available outside.
exports.label: Available after the loop

count.description: How many times to run Body, from 0 up to the maximum iterations.
count.label: Count

while.label: While
while.description: Check Condition before each iteration and run Body while it gives yes.

maxIterations.description: The loop stops with an error if it would run more often than this; at most 1000.
maxIterations.label: Maximum iterations

carry.description: Values each iteration can read and change, each starting from a value you set.
carry.label: Kept between iterations

exports.description: Values set inside the loop for steps after it; nothing else made inside the loop is available outside.
exports.label: Available after the loop

until.label: Until
until.description: Run Body, then check Condition, and repeat until it gives yes.

maxIterations.description: The loop stops with an error if it would run more often than this; at most 1000.
maxIterations.label: Maximum iterations

carry.description: Values each iteration can read and change, each starting from a value you set.
carry.label: Kept between iterations

exports.description: Values set inside the loop for steps after it; nothing else made inside the loop is available outside.
exports.label: Available after the loop

foreach.label: For each
foreach.description: Run the steps in Body once for each item in a list.

maxIterations.description: The loop stops with an error if it would run more often than this; at most 1000.
maxIterations.label: Maximum iterations

carry.description: Values each iteration can read and change, each starting from a value you set.
carry.label: Kept between iterations

exports.description: Values set inside the loop for steps after it; nothing else made inside the loop is available outside.
exports.label: Available after the loop

itemType.description: The type every item must have; if any item has another type, the loop fails before it starts.
itemType.label: Item type

items.description: The list to go through. It is copied when the loop starts, so later changes do not affect it.
items.label: Items

item.description: The item of the current iteration; only available inside Body.
item.label: Item

index.description: The position of the current item, counting from 0; only available inside Body.
index.label: Index

parallel.label: Parallel
parallel.description: Run several branches at the same time, then continue with Done when all have finished.

branches.description: The branches to run at the same time. Values made in one branch are not available to the others or after it.
branches.label: Branches

condition_result.label: Condition result
condition_result.description: End the Condition of a While or Until loop with a yes/no answer.

value.description: Yes keeps While going and stops Until; no does the opposite.
value.label: Condition

loop_result.label: Loop result
loop_result.description: Finish this iteration, setting Kept between iterations and Available after the loop.

values.description: New values for Kept between iterations and Available after the loop; a value left out keeps what it had.
values.label: Values

wait_until.label: Wait until
wait_until.description: Wait until an entity's state or an attribute matches a value, or fail when time runs out.

field.description: Whether to check the entity's state or one of its attributes.
field.label: Field

attribute.description: The attribute to check, such as brightness or temperature; needed when checking an attribute.
attribute.label: Attribute

type.description: The type of the value to compare, such as Number for a temperature.
type.label: Type

operator.description: How to compare. Less than, at most, greater than and at least work only with numbers.
operator.label: Operator

entity.description: The entity to watch; its latest state is read at every check.
entity.label: Entity

right.description: The value to compare the state or attribute with, such as on or 20.
right.label: Expected value

timeout.description: How many seconds to wait at most; when the time runs out, the step takes its On error path.
timeout.label: Timeout

interval.description: How many seconds to wait between checks.
interval.label: Poll interval

object.label: Object
object.description: Provide an object you write out, such as data for a service.

value.description: The object to provide, such as {"brightness": 80}.
value.label: Object

array.label: List
array.description: Provide a list you write out, such as a list of entity ids.

value.description: The list to provide, such as ["light.hall", "light.porch"].
value.label: List

object_create.label: Create object
object_create.description: Build an object from named fields, each set or connected on its own.

fields.description: The object's fields by name; each field gets its own input.
fields.label: Fields

value.description: The object, with a field for each input.
value.label: Object

array_create.label: Create list
array_create.description: Build a list from items, each set or connected on its own.

items.description: The list's items in order; each item gets its own input.
items.label: Items

value.description: The list, with the items in order.
value.label: List

get_field.label: Get field
get_field.description: Take one value out of an object or list, such as a field of a service response.

pointer.description: Where the value is, such as /to_state/attributes/brightness or /items/0. Leave empty for the whole value.
pointer.label: Path

type.description: The type of the value you expect, such as Number; a value of another type fails the step that uses it.
type.label: Type

value.description: The object or list to take the value from, such as Trigger data.
value.label: Source

value.description: The value found at the path.
value.label: Value

entity_field.label: Entity field
entity_field.description: Get the state or one attribute from an entity state, as the type you choose.

field.description: Whether to take the entity's state or one of its attributes.
field.label: Field

attribute.description: The attribute to take, such as brightness or friendly_name; needed when taking an attribute.
attribute.label: Attribute

type.description: The type to turn the value into, such as Number for a temperature sensor's state.
type.label: Type

entity.label: Entity state
entity.description: The entity state to read from, such as a trigger's New state or what Read entity gives.

value.description: The state or attribute, as the chosen type.
value.label: Value

data.label: Trigger data
data.description: All the data the trigger passed to the run.

to_state.label: New state
to_state.description: The entity's state after the change.

from_state.label: Previous state
from_state.description: The entity's state before the change; missing when the entity had no state before.

planned.label: Planned time
planned.description: When the run was planned to start, in UTC, such as 2026-12-24T17:00:00Z.

entity_id.label: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity that set off the trigger.

to_state.label: New state
to_state.description: The entity's state after the change.

from_state.label: Previous state
from_state.description: The entity's state before the change; missing when the entity had no state before.

entity_id.label: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity, such as a person, that entered or left the zone.

zone.label: Zone
zone.description: The zone's entity id, such as zone.home.

event.label: Event
event.description: Whether the entity entered or left: enter or leave.

event_type.label: Event type
event_type.description: The type of the event, such as call_service.

event_data.label: Event data
event_data.description: The data that came with the event.

now.label: Time
now.description: When the trigger fired, such as 2026-12-24T07:30:00+01:00.

event.label: Event
event.description: Which event it was: sunrise or sunset, or start or shutdown of Home Assistant.

json.label: JSON body
json.description: The JSON the webhook call sent.

query.label: Query
query.description: The query parameters of the webhook address.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: The MQTT topic the message arrived on.

payload.label: Payload
payload.description: The content of the MQTT message, as text.

execution.description: Runs the next step; on a State condition, next means the same as true.

data.description: Passes a value into an input. A step's value must have been made by an earlier step; a value node is worked out each time a step uses it.

initial.description: The value before the first iteration; needed even when the loop runs zero times.

literal.description: A value written into the step.

unset.description: No value. Connecting a wire and then removing it never brings back an earlier value.

scopeContract.parallelJoin: All branch executions complete before next. Branch values and the most recent failure are isolated and never implicitly merged.
